#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Per-probe methylation difference: smokers vs never-smokers (EWAS / DMP test).

Data:
  - Beta-value (methylation level, 0-1) matrix, 300 probes x 10 samples
    (5 smokers A1-A5, 5 never-smokers B1-B5).
  - Sample sheet with exposure labels.

Method:
  - Statistics are run on M-values, M = log2(beta / (1 - beta)) (beta-values
    are heteroscedastic; M-values have stable variance).
  - Per probe: two-sample Welch t-test (two-sided) on M-values,
    smoker group vs never-smoker group.
  - Group difference reported on the beta scale (delta_beta =
    mean_beta_smoker - mean_beta_never) and as log2 fold change of
    methylation odds (log2fc_mvalue = mean_M_smoker - mean_M_never).
  - Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all probes.

Probe IDs carry no chromosomal annotation in this workspace, so results are
reported by CpG ID only.
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from pathlib import Path

WORKDIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
METH_PATH = Path("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meth/methylation_levels.csv")
SAMPLES_PATH = Path("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meta/samples.csv")
OUT_DIR = WORKDIR / "output"
FIG_DIR = WORKDIR / "figures"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
FIG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load
beta_df = pd.read_csv(METH_PATH, index_col="probe")
samples = pd.read_csv(SAMPLES_PATH)
samples = samples.set_index("sample")

smokers = [s for s in samples.index if samples.loc[s, "exposure"] == "smoker"]
nevers = [s for s in samples.index if samples.loc[s, "exposure"] == "never_smoker"]
assert set(beta_df.columns) == set(samples.index), "sample mismatch"
beta_df = beta_df[smokers + nevers]

n = len(smokers)
assert n == len(nevers) == 5, (smokers, nevers)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- M-values
# Clip to (0, 1) to guard the logit (values are already strictly inside);
# record how many were clipped.
EPS = 1e-6
clipped = int(np.sum((beta_df.values <= 0) | (beta_df.values >= 1)))
beta = beta_df.values.clip(EPS, 1 - EPS)
mval = np.log2(beta / (1.0 - beta))

sm_s, nv_s = mval[:, :n], mval[:, n:]
beta_s, beta_nv = beta[:, :n], beta[:, n:]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Welch t-test per probe
ms, mn = sm_s.mean(axis=1), nv_s.mean(axis=1)
vs, vn = sm_s.var(axis=1, ddof=1), nv_s.var(axis=1, ddof=1)

denom = np.sqrt(vs / n + vn / n)
tstat = np.full(len(beta_df), np.nan)
df = np.full(len(beta_df), np.nan)
pval = np.full(len(beta_df), np.nan)

# regular case
ok = denom > 0
with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
    tstat[ok] = (ms[ok] - mn[ok]) / denom[ok]
    df[ok] = (vs[ok] / n + vn[ok] / n) ** 2 / (
        (vs[ok] / n) ** 2 / (n - 1) + (vn[ok] / n) ** 2 / (n - 1)
    )
    pval[ok] = 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(tstat[ok]), df[ok])

# degenerate case: no variance estimate in either group (denom == 0)
degen = ~ok
if np.any(degen):
    pval[degen] = np.where(ms[degen] == mn[degen], 1.0, 0.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- BH FDR
order = np.argsort(pval)
ranks = np.empty(len(pval), dtype=float)
ranks[order] = np.arange(1, len(pval) + 1)
adj = pval * len(pval) / ranks
# enforce monotonicity from largest p down
adj_sorted_idx = order[::-1]
adj_sorted = adj[adj_sorted_idx]
cummin = np.minimum.accumulate(adj_sorted[::-1])[::-1]
adj[adj_sorted_idx] = np.clip(cummin, None, 1.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- results table
results = pd.DataFrame({
    "cpg_id": beta_df.index,
    "mean_beta_smoker": ms_beta if (ms_beta := beta_s.mean(axis=1)) else None,
    "mean_beta_never": beta_nv.mean(axis=1),
    "delta_beta": beta_s.mean(axis=1) - beta_nv.mean(axis=1),  # smoker - never
    "log2fc_mvalue": ms - mn,
    "t_statistic": tstat,
    "df": df,
    "pvalue": pval,
    "adjusted_pvalue": adj,
})
results = results.sort_values(["adjusted_pvalue", "cpg_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
results.to_csv(OUT_DIR / "dmp_results.csv", index=False)

# summary numbers
padj = results["adjusted_pvalue"].to_numpy()
sig = (padj < 0.05) & (results["delta_beta"].abs() > 0.05)
n_sig = int(sig.sum())
n_up = int((sig & (results["delta_beta"] > 0)).sum())
n_down = int((sig & (results["delta_beta"] < 0)).sum())
n_nosig_p = int(np.sum(~np.isfinite(pval)))
n_degen = int(np.sum(degen))
top10 = results.head(10)

print(f"Probes tested: {len(results)}  (clipped for logit: {clipped}, zero-variance pairs: {n_degen})")
print(f"Significant (padj<0.05 & |delta_beta|>0.05): {n_sig}  (up in smokers: {n_up}, down: {n_down})")
print(f"Raw p significant (p<0.05): {int(np.sum(pval < 0.05))}")
print(f"Top 10 by adjusted p:\n{top10[['cpg_id','delta_beta','log2fc_mvalue','pvalue','adjusted_pvalue']].to_string(index=False)}")

# duplicate-column check (technical replicates?): max |diff| across sample pairs
B = beta_df.values
pairs = {}
for i in range(B.shape[1]):
    for j in range(i + 1, B.shape[1]):
        pairs[(beta_df.columns[i], beta_df.columns[j])] = float(np.abs(B[:, i] - B[:, j]).max())
dup = sorted(pairs.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])
print("\nLargest within-matrix sample-pair differences (max |delta| across probes):")
for (a, b), v in dup[:6]:
    print(f"  {a} vs {b}: {v:.3f}")
for (a, b), v in dup[-6:]:
    print(f"  {a} vs {b}: {v:.3f}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- AnnData
import anndata as ad

a = ad.AnnData(
    X=beta,
    var=pd.DataFrame(index=beta_df.index, data={"cpg_id": beta_df.index}),
    obs=pd.DataFrame(
        index=beta_df.columns,
        data={"exposure": [samples.loc[s, "exposure"] for s in beta_df.columns]},
    ),
)
a.layers["mvalue"] = mval
a.var["cpg_id"] = a.var_names
a.write_h5ad(OUT_DIR / "methylation.h5ad")
print(f"\nWrote {OUT_DIR/'dmp_results.csv'} and {OUT_DIR/'methylation.h5ad'}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- volcano figure
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

x = results["delta_beta"].to_numpy()
y = -np.log10(results["pvalue"].clip(lower=1e-300))
sig_mask = sig.to_numpy()
up_mask = sig_mask & (x > 0)
down_mask = sig_mask & (x < 0)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6), dpi=300)
ax.scatter(x[~sig_mask], y[~sig_mask], s=18, c="#8b98a5", alpha=0.7,
           label=f"Not significant (n={int((~sig_mask).sum())})", edgecolors="none")
ax.scatter(x[down_mask], y[down_mask], s=28, c="#440154", alpha=0.9,
           label=f"Hyper/ hypomethylated (n={int(sig_mask.sum())}", edgecolors="none")
ax.scatter(x[up_mask], y[up_mask], s=28, c="#fde725", alpha=0.95,
           edgecolors="#333333", linewidths=0.4, label="")
# re-plot so legend entries are explicit
ax.scatter([], [], s=28, c="#440154", label=f"Higher in never-smokers (n={int(down_mask.sum())})")
ax.scatter([], [], s=28, c="#fde725", edgecolors="#333333", linewidths=0.4,
           label=f"Higher in smokers (n={int(up_mask.sum())})")
ax.scatter([], [], s=18, c="#8b98a5", label=f"Not significant (n={int((~sig_mask).sum())})")

ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color="#333333", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.axvline(0.05, color="#333333", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.axvline(-0.05, color="#333333", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.text(0.051, ax.get_ylim()[1] * 0.97, "|delta beta| > 0.05", fontsize=8, va="top")

# label top 10 by adjusted p
lab = results.head(10)
for _, r in lab.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(
        r["cpg_id"],
        xy=(r["delta_beta"], -np.log10(max(r["pvalue"], 1e-300))),
        fontsize=6.5,
        xytext=(4, 3), textcoords="offset points",
    )

ax.set_xlabel(r"delta beta (mean beta smoker $-$ never-smoker)")
ax.set_ylabel(r"$-$log$_{10}(p)$, per-probe t-test on M-values")
ax.set_title(f"Per-probe EWAS: smokers vs never-smokers (n = 5 vs 5)\n"
             f"{n_sig} probes with padj < 0.05 and |delta beta| > 0.05")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(FIG_DIR / "volcano_dmp_smoking.png", dpi=300)
fig.savefig(FIG_DIR / "volcano_dmp_smoking.pdf")
print(f"Wrote {FIG_DIR/'volcano_dmp_smoking.png'}.pdf")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Per-probe methylation difference: smokers vs never-smokers (EWAS / DMP test).

Data:
  - Beta-value (methylation level, 0-1) matrix, 300 probes x 10 samples
    (5 smokers A1-A5, 5 never-smokers B1-B5).
  - Sample sheet with exposure labels.

Method:
  - Statistics are run on M-values, M = log2(beta / (1 - beta)). Beta-values
    are heteroscedastic (variance depends on the mean); M-values have stable
    variance, so they are the correct scale for the t-test.
  - Per probe: two-sample Welch t-test (two-sided) on M-values,
    smoker group vs never-smoker group.
  - The group difference is reported on the beta scale for interpretation:
    delta_beta = mean_beta_smoker - mean_beta_never, and as the log2 fold
    change of methylation odds (log2fc_mvalue = mean_M_smoker - mean_M_never).
  - Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all 300 probes.

Probe IDs carry no chromosomal/gene annotation in this workspace, so results
are reported by CpG ID only.
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from scipy.stats import false_discovery_control
from pathlib import Path

WORKDIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
METH_PATH = Path("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meth/methylation_levels.csv")
SAMPLES_PATH = Path("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meta/samples.csv")
OUT_DIR = WORKDIR / "output"
FIG_DIR = WORKDIR / "figures"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
FIG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load
beta_df = pd.read_csv(METH_PATH, index_col="probe")
samples = pd.read_csv(SAMPLES_PATH).set_index("sample")

smokers = [s for s in samples.index if samples.loc[s, "exposure"] == "smoker"]
nevers = [s for s in samples.index if samples.loc[s, "exposure"] == "never_smoker"]
assert set(beta_df.columns) == set(samples.index), "sample columns mismatch sheet"
beta_df = beta_df[smokers + nevers]

n = len(smokers)
assert n == len(nevers) == 5, (smokers, nevers)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- M-values
# Clip to (0, 1) to keep the logit finite (data are already strictly inside);
# record how many would have been clipped.
EPS = 1e-6
clipped = int(np.sum((beta_df.values <= 0) | (beta_df.values >= 1)))
beta = beta_df.values.clip(EPS, 1 - EPS)
mval = np.log2(beta / (1.0 - beta))          # M-values, shape (300, 10)

sm_s, nv_s = mval[:, :n], mval[:, n:]
beta_s, beta_nv = beta[:, :n], beta[:, n:]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Welch t-test per probe
ms, mn = sm_s.mean(axis=1), nv_s.mean(axis=1)
vs, vn = sm_s.var(axis=1, ddof=1), nv_s.var(axis=1, ddof=1)

denom = np.sqrt(vs / n + vn / n)
tstat = np.full(len(beta_df), np.nan)
dof = np.full(len(beta_df), np.nan)
pval = np.full(len(beta_df), np.nan)

ok = denom > 0
with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
    tstat[ok] = (ms[ok] - mn[ok]) / denom[ok]
    dof[ok] = (vs[ok] / n + vn[ok] / n) ** 2 / (
        (vs[ok] / n) ** 2 / (n - 1) + (vn[ok] / n) ** 2 / (n - 1)
    )
    pval[ok] = 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(tstat[ok]), dof[ok])

# Degenerate probes: no variance estimate in EITHER group (denom == 0).
# If the two means are equal -> no evidence of a difference (p = 1);
# otherwise the difference is unambiguously real -> p = 0.
degen = ~ok
if np.any(degen):
    pval[degen] = np.where(ms[degen] == mn[degen], 1.0, 0.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- BH FDR
# scipy's step-up Benjamini-Hochberg (monotone, bounded in [0, 1]).
adj = false_discovery_control(pval)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- results table
mean_beta_smoker = beta_s.mean(axis=1)
mean_beta_never = beta_nv.mean(axis=1)
results = pd.DataFrame({
    "cpg_id": beta_df.index,
    "mean_beta_smoker": mean_beta_smoker,
    "mean_beta_never": mean_beta_never,
    "delta_beta": mean_beta_smoker - mean_beta_never,   # smoker - never
    "log2fc_mvalue": ms - mn,
    "t_statistic": tstat,
    "df": dof,
    "pvalue": pval,
    "adjusted_pvalue": adj,
})
results = results.sort_values(["adjusted_pvalue", "cpg_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
results.to_csv(OUT_DIR / "dmp_results.csv", index=False)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- summary
padj = results["adjusted_pvalue"].to_numpy()
sig = (padj < 0.05) & (results["delta_beta"].abs() > 0.05)
n_sig = int(sig.sum())
n_up = int((sig & (results["delta_beta"] > 0)).sum())
n_down = int((sig & (results["delta_beta"] < 0)).sum())
n_degen = int(np.sum(degen))
top10 = results.head(10)

print(f"Probes tested: {len(results)}  (values clipped for logit: {clipped}, "
      f"zero-variance-in-both-groups: {n_degen})")
print(f"Significant (padj<0.05 & |delta_beta|>0.05): {n_sig}  "
      f"(hyper in smokers: {n_up}, hypo in smokers: {n_down})")
print(f"Raw p < 0.05: {int(np.sum(pval < 0.05))}")
print("\nTop 10 by adjusted p:")
print(top10[["cpg_id", "delta_beta", "log2fc_mvalue", "pvalue",
             "adjusted_pvalue"]].to_string(index=False))

# Within-group variance sanity check: largest |diff| across sample pairs
B = beta_df.values
pairs = {}
for i in range(B.shape[1]):
    for j in range(i + 1, B.shape[1]):
        pairs[(beta_df.columns[i], beta_df.columns[j])] = \
            float(np.abs(B[:, i] - B[:, j]).max())
dup = sorted(pairs.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])
print("\nSample-pair max |delta| across probes (within-group should be small):")
for (a, b), v in dup[:5]:
    print(f"  {a} vs {b}: {v:.3f}")
for (a, b), v in dup[-5:]:
    print(f"  {a} vs {b}: {v:.3f}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- AnnData
# AnnData convention: rows = samples (obs), columns = probes (var).
import anndata as ad

a = ad.AnnData(
    X=beta.T,                      # (10 samples, 300 probes)
    var=pd.DataFrame(index=beta_df.index, data={"cpg_id": beta_df.index}),
    obs=pd.DataFrame(
        index=beta_df.columns,
        data={"exposure": [samples.loc[s, "exposure"] for s in beta_df.columns]},
    ),
)
a.layers["mvalue"] = mval.T        # M-value layer, same orientation
a.obs.index.name = "sample"
a.var.index.name = "probe"
a.write_h5ad(OUT_DIR / "methylation.h5ad")
print(f"\nWrote {OUT_DIR / 'dmp_results.csv'} and {OUT_DIR / 'methylation.h5ad'}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- volcano figure
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

x = results["delta_beta"].to_numpy()
y = -np.log10(np.clip(results["pvalue"].to_numpy(), 1e-300, None))
sig_mask = sig.to_numpy()
up_mask = sig_mask & (x > 0)
down_mask = sig_mask & (x < 0)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6), dpi=300)
ax.scatter(x[~sig_mask], y[~sig_mask], s=18, c="#8b98a5", alpha=0.7,
           edgecolors="none")
ax.scatter(x[down_mask], y[down_mask], s=28, c="#440154", alpha=0.9,
           edgecolors="none")
ax.scatter(x[up_mask], y[up_mask], s=28, c="#fde725", alpha=0.95,
           edgecolors="#333333", linewidths=0.4)
# explicit legend handles
ax.scatter([], [], s=28, c="#440154",
           label=f"Lower methylation in smokers (n={int(down_mask.sum())})")
ax.scatter([], [], s=28, c="#fde725", edgecolors="#333333", linewidths=0.4,
           label=f"Higher methylation in smokers (n={int(up_mask.sum())})")
ax.scatter([], [], s=18, c="#8b98a5",
           label=f"Not significant (n={int((~sig_mask).sum())})")

ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color="#333333", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.axvline(0.05, color="#333333", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.axvline(-0.05, color="#333333", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.text(0.055, ax.get_ylim()[1] * 0.98, "|delta beta| > 0.05",
        fontsize=8, va="top")

for _, r in top10.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(

The analysis is complete. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Results: Per-Probe Smoking vs Never-Smoker Methylation Test

**Method:** Welch t-test on M-values (logit of beta) per probe, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across all 300 probes.

**Key findings:**
- **300 probes tested**, 0 clipped for logit, 1 degenerate (constant across all samples, cg10000592)
- **19 probes** had raw p < 0.05
- **16 probes** met the significance threshold (padj < 0.05 AND |Δβ| > 0.05)
- **All 16 significant probes show hypomethylation in smokers** (negative Δβ, i.e., lower methylation in smokers)
- Top hit: **cg10000111** (Δβ = −0.335, padj ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁸)
- Largest effect: **cg10000074** (Δβ = −0.438)

**Data caveat:** Within-group sample pairs show very small differences (max |Δ| ≈ 0.02), suggesting possible technical replicate structure or rounding at 3 decimal places. The effective n=5/group should be interpreted cautiously.

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Genotype effect on the proteome: knockout vs wildtype, label-free DDA.

Workflow (per proteomics domain standard for DDA):
  1. Load MaxQuant LFQ intensities + sample sheet (8 lines: 4 KO, 4 WT;
     2 lines of each genotype on each of 2 run days).
  2. Missing-value assessment: classify each protein's missingness MNAR
     vs MAR.
  3. Filter: keep proteins detected in >= 70% of at least one group
     (>= 3/4 in KO or >= 3/4 in WT).
  4. Log2 transform LFQ intensities.
  5. Normalize: VSN (variance-stabilizing) + per-sample median centering
     (removes the run-day intensity offset).
  6. Impute remaining missing values: MinProb-style left-censored
     imputation (expected value under a normal model censored at the
     per-sample detection floor) -- appropriate for the MNAR pattern.
  7. DE: limma, design = intercept + genotype + run_day (run day as
     batch covariate; design is balanced, 2 lines/genotype/day).
     Contrast: knockout vs wildtype. BH adjustment.
  8. Figures: normalization before/after, missing-value heatmap,
     PCA (genotype / batch), volcano.

Outputs (relative to working dir):
  output/processed_matrix.csv, output/processed_matrix.h5ad
  output/de_results.csv, output/protein_id_mapping.csv
  output/missing_value_assessment.csv
  figures/{normalization_before_after, missing_value_heatmap,
           pca_genotype_batch, volcano_ko_vs_wt}.{png,pdf}
"""

import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.cluster.hierarchy as shc
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
INPUT_MATRIX = "/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-prot/protein_intensities.tsv"
INPUT_META = "/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meta/samples.csv"
OUT_DIR = "output"
FIG_DIR = "figures"
LFC_THRESHOLD = 1.0
PADJ_THRESHOLD = 0.05
MIN_DETECTION_FRAC = 0.70  # domain standard: detected in >=70% of one group

KO_SAMPLES = ["KO1", "KO2", "KO3", "KO4"]
WT_SAMPLES = ["WT1", "WT2", "WT3", "WT4"]
ALL_SAMPLES = KO_SAMPLES + WT_SAMPLES

os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(FIG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 100, "savefig.dpi": 300})
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_MATRIX, sep="\t", index_col="protein_id")
gene = df.pop("gene")
expr = df[ALL_SAMPLES].astype(float)
meta = pd.read_csv(INPUT_META).set_index("sample").loc[ALL_SAMPLES]

n_total_missing = int(expr.isna().sum().sum())

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Missing-value assessment (MNAR vs MAR), on raw LFQ scale ranks
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# A protein's missingness is MNAR (below-detection) when the detected
# values sit at the low end of the per-sample abundance range; MAR when
# they sit mid-range (random technical dropout).
rank = expr.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
mean_int_log = np.log2(expr.fillna(np.nanmean(expr, axis=1)))  # placeholder, refined below

miss_info = []
for pid in expr.index:
    row = expr.loc[pid]
    det = row.dropna()
    miss_n = int(row.isna().sum())
    if miss_n == 0:
        pattern = "complete"
    else:
        # per-sample pct-rank of this protein's detected values
        ranks = rank.loc[pid].dropna()
        mean_rank = float(ranks.mean())
        # low-abundance protein? compare its mean detected intensity to
        # the global median of row means
        row_med = det.median()
        global_med = det.median()  # replaced below
        pattern = "MNAR" if mean_rank < 0.40 else "MAR"
    miss_info.append(
        {
            "protein": pid,
            "gene": gene[pid],
            "n_missing": miss_n,
            "n_missing_ko": int(expr.loc[pid, KO_SAMPLES].isna().sum()),
            "n_missing_wt": int(expr.loc[pid, WT_SAMPLES].isna().sum()),
            "n_missing_day1": int(expr.loc[pid, meta[meta["run_day"] == "day1"].index].isna().sum()),
            "n_missing_day2": int(expr.loc[pid, meta[meta["run_day"] == "day2"].index].isna().sum()),
            "mean_detected_lfq": float(det.mean()) if miss_n else float("nan"),
            "pattern": pattern,
        }
    )
miss_df = pd.DataFrame(miss_info).set_index("protein")
# refine global median of log2 row means for context
log2_all = np.log2(expr)
row_means = log2_all.mean(axis=1)
global_row_med = float(row_means.median())
miss_df["low_abundance"] = miss_df["mean_detected_lfq"].apply(
    lambda v: (np.log2(v) < global_row_med) if np.isfinite(v) else False
)
miss_df.to_csv(f"{OUT_DIR}/missing_value_assessment.csv")
print(
    "Missing-value assessment: total missing cells =",
    n_total_missing,
    "| pattern counts:",
    miss_df["pattern"].value_counts().to_dict(),
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Filter: detected in >= 70% of at least one group
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
det_ko = expr[KO_SAMPLES].notna().sum(axis=1)
det_wt = expr[WT_SAMPLES].notna().sum(axis=1)
n_per_group = 4
keep = (det_ko >= MIN_DETECTION_FRAC * n_per_group) | (det_wt >= MIN_DETECTION_FRAC * n_per_group)
n_dropped = int((~keep).sum())
print(f"Filter (>=70% detected in at least one group): dropped {n_dropped}, kept {int(keep.sum())}")
expr = expr[keep]
gene = gene[keep]
log2_all = log2_all[keep]
miss_df = miss_df.loc[keep]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Log2 (already computed above, filtered)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
log2 = log2_all.copy()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Normalize: VSN + median centering (rpy2 -> R)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
import rpy2.robjects as ro
from rpy2.robjects.packages import importr

base = ro.r
vsn_pkg = importr("vsn")
base.set.seed(42)

x_r = ro.FloatVector(log2.values.ravel(order="F"))
x_r = base.matrix(x_r, nrow=len(log2), byrow=FALSE := False)
x_r = base.matrix(ro.FloatVector(log2.values.ravel(order="F")), nrow=len(log2), byrow=False)
base.rownames(x_r) = ro.StrVector(list(log2.index))
base.colnames(x_r) = ro.StrVector(list(log2.columns))

# VSN with nsv chosen by default likelihood (nsv=1 default)
vsn_mat = vsn_pkg.vsnMatrix(x_r)
vsn_val = np.array(ro.conversion.get_conversion().rpy2py(vsn_mat)).T
norm = pd.DataFrame(vsn_val, index=log2.index, columns=log2.columns)
# median centering: remove run-day/sample intensity offsets
norm = norm.sub(norm.median(axis=0), axis=1)
print("VSN + median centering done. Sample medians (should be ~0):",
      {c: round(v, 4) for c, v in norm.median(axis=0).items()})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. MinProb-style left-censored imputation (deterministic, normal model)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per sample j, the detection floor c_j = min detected value. A missing
# (protein i, sample j) is imputed as E[X | X < c_j] under N(mu_i, s_i^2),
# mu_i, s_i from protein i's detected values (normal left-censoring, the
# MinProb principle; imputeLCENS not available in this environment).
from scipy.special import erf

def norm_cdf(z):
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(z / np.sqrt(2.0)))

def norm_pdf(z):
    return np.exp(-0.5 * z**2) / np.sqrt(2.0 * np.pi)

floors = norm.min(axis=0)  # per-sample detection floor
imputed = norm.copy()
n_imputed = 0
for pid in imputed.index:
    row = imputed.loc[pid]
    if not row.isna().any():
        continue
    det_vals = row.dropna().values
    mu = float(det_vals.mean())
    s = float(det_vals.std(ddof=1)) if len(det_vals) >= 2 else float(norm.std(axis=0).mean())
    s = max(s, 0.25)  # small lower bound against degenerate variance
    for col in row.index[row.isna()]:
        c = floors[col]
        if c <= mu:
            # floor below the protein's own mean: treat as random dropout,
            # impute with a censored expectation anyway (safe, bounded)
            pass
        z = (c - mu) / s
        e = mu - s * norm_pdf(z) / max(norm_cdf(z), 1e-9)
        # keep the imputed value in a sane range
        e = max(e, c - 3.0 * s)
        imputed.loc[pid, col] = e
        n_imputed += 1
processed = imputed
print(f"Imputed {n_imputed} missing values (MinProb left-censored normal model).")
assert not processed.isna().any().any()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. DE: limma, design ~ genotype + run_day, contrast KO vs WT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with ro.default_converter + ro.packages2ri_converter := None:
    pass  # placeholder removed below

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Genotype effect on the proteome: knockout vs wildtype, label-free DDA.

Workflow (per proteomics domain standard for DDA):
  1. Load MaxQuant LFQ intensities + sample sheet (8 lines: 4 KO, 4 WT;
     2 lines of each genotype on each of 2 run days).
  2. Missing-value assessment: classify each protein's missingness MNAR
     vs MAR.
  3. Filter: keep proteins detected in >= 70% of at least one group
     (>= 3/4 in KO or >= 3/4 in WT).
  4. Log2 transform LFQ intensities.
  5. Normalize: VSN (variance-stabilizing) + per-sample median centering
     (removes the run-day intensity offset).
  6. Impute remaining missing values: MinProb-style left-censored
     imputation (expected value under a normal model censored at the
     per-sample detection floor) -- appropriate for the MNAR pattern.
     (imputeLCENS, the usual implementation, is not available in this
     environment, so the MinProb principle is applied directly.)
  7. DE: limma, design = intercept + genotype + run_day (run day as
     batch covariate; design is balanced, 2 lines/genotype/day).
     Contrast: knockout vs wildtype. BH adjustment.
  8. Figures: normalization before/after, missing-value heatmap,
     PCA (genotype / batch), volcano.

Outputs (relative to working dir):
  output/processed_matrix.csv, output/processed_matrix.h5ad
  output/de_results.csv, output/protein_id_mapping.csv
  output/missing_value_assessment.csv
  figures/{normalization_before_after, missing_value_heatmap,
           pca_genotype_batch, volcano_ko_vs_wt}.{png,pdf}
"""

import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.cluster.hierarchy as shc
from scipy.special import erf
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
INPUT_MATRIX = "/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-prot/protein_intensities.tsv"
INPUT_META = "/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-meta/samples.csv"
OUT_DIR = "output"
FIG_DIR = "figures"
LFC_THRESHOLD = 1.0
PADJ_THRESHOLD = 0.05
MIN_DETECTION_FRAC = 0.70  # domain standard: detected in >=70% of one group
MNAR_RANK_CUTOFF = 0.40  # protein's detected values in bottom 40% of the
#                        # per-sample abundance range => below-LOD missingness

KO_SAMPLES = ["KO1", "KO2", "KO3", "KO4"]
WT_SAMPLES = ["WT1", "WT2", "WT3", "WT4"]
ALL_SAMPLES = KO_SAMPLES + WT_SAMPLES

os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(FIG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({"savefig.dpi": 300})
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_MATRIX, sep="\t", index_col="protein_id")
gene = df.pop("gene")
expr = df[ALL_SAMPLES].astype(float)
meta = pd.read_csv(INPUT_META).set_index("sample").loc[ALL_SAMPLES]

n_total_missing = int(expr.isna().sum().sum())

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Missing-value assessment (MNAR vs MAR)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# A protein's missingness is MNAR (below detection limit) when its
# detected values sit at the low end of the per-sample abundance range;
# MAR (random technical dropout) when they sit mid-range.
rank = expr.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

miss_info = []
for pid in expr.index:
    row = expr.loc[pid]
    det = row.dropna()
    miss_n = int(row.isna().sum())
    mean_rank = float(rank.loc[pid].dropna().mean())
    if miss_n == 0:
        pattern = "complete"
    else:
        pattern = "MNAR" if mean_rank < MNAR_RANK_CUTOFF else "MAR"
    miss_info.append(
        {
            "protein": pid,
            "gene": gene[pid],
            "n_missing": miss_n,
            "n_missing_ko": int(row[KO_SAMPLES].isna().sum()),
            "n_missing_wt": int(row[WT_SAMPLES].isna().sum()),
            "n_missing_day1": int(row[meta[meta["run_day"] == "day1"].index].isna().sum()),
            "n_missing_day2": int(row[meta[meta["run_day"] == "day2"].index].isna().sum()),
            "mean_detected_lfq": float(det.mean()),
            "mean_pct_rank_detected": mean_rank,
            "pattern": pattern,
        }
    )
miss_df = pd.DataFrame(miss_info).set_index("protein")
miss_df.to_csv(f"{OUT_DIR}/missing_value_assessment.csv")
print("Missing-value assessment:")
print(f"  total missing cells: {n_total_missing} / {expr.size}")
print(f"  pattern counts: {miss_df['pattern'].value_counts().to_dict()}")
# balance of missingness across genotypes / days (confounding check)
print(
    f"  mean missing/line: KO={miss_df['n_missing_ko'].sum() / 4:.2f} "
    f"WT={miss_df['n_missing_wt'].sum() / 4:.2f} "
    f"day1={miss_df['n_missing_day1'].sum() / 4:.2f} "
    f"day2={miss_df['n_missing_day2'].sum() / 4:.2f}"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Filter: detected in >= 70% of at least one group
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
det_ko = expr[KO_SAMPLES].notna().sum(axis=1)
det_wt = expr[WT_SAMPLES].notna().sum(axis=1)
n_per_group = 4
keep = (det_ko >= MIN_DETECTION_FRAC * n_per_group) | (det_wt >= MIN_DETECTION_FRAC * n_per_group)
n_dropped = int((~keep).sum())
dropped_ids = list(expr.index[~keep])
print(f"Filter (>=70% detected in at least one group): dropped {n_dropped}, kept {int(keep.sum())}")
if n_dropped:
    print("  dropped:", ", ".join(f"{p} ({gene[p]})" for p in dropped_ids))
expr = expr[keep]
gene = gene[keep]
miss_df = miss_df.loc[keep]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Log2 transform
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
log2 = np.log2(expr)
raw_log2_median = log2.median(axis=0)  # per sample, before normalization
log2_before = log2.copy()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Normalize: VSN + per-sample median centering (rpy2 -> R)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
import rpy2.robjects as ro
from rpy2.robjects.packages import importr

base = ro.r
vsn_pkg = importr("vsn")
base.set.seed(42)

x_r = base.matrix(
    ro.FloatVector(log2.values.ravel(order="F")), nrow=len(log2), byrow=False
)
base.rownames(x_r) = ro.StrVector(list(log2.index))
base.colnames(x_r) = ro.StrVector(list(log2.columns))

vsn_mat = vsn_pkg.vsnMatrix(x_r)
vsn_val = np.asarray(ro.conversion.get_conversion().rpy2py(vsn_mat)).T
norm = pd.DataFrame(vsn_val, index=log2.index, columns=log2.columns)
# median centering: removes the run-day / per-sample intensity offset
norm = norm.sub(norm.median(axis=0), axis=1)
print("VSN + median centering done. Sample medians (should be ~0):")
print(norm.median(axis=0).round(4).to_dict())

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. MinProb-style left-censored imputation (deterministic normal model)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per sample j, detection floor c_j = min detected (normalized) value.
# A missing (protein i, sample j) is imputed as E[X | X < c_j] under
# N(mu_i, s_i^2) with mu_i, s_i from protein i's detected values -- the
# MinProb principle (left-censored expectation).
def norm_cdf(z):
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(z / np.sqrt(2.0)))


def norm_pdf(z):
    return np.exp(-0.5 * z**2) / np.sqrt(2.0 * np.pi)


floors = norm.min(axis=0)  # per-sample detection floor (normalized scale)
processed = norm.copy()
n_imputed = 0
for pid in processed.index:
    row = processed.loc[pid]
    if not row.isna().any():
        continue
    det_vals = row.dropna().to_numpy()
    mu = float(det_vals.mean())
    s = float(det_vals.std(ddof=1)) if len(det_vals) >= 2 else float(norm.std(axis=0).mean())
    s = max(s, 0.25)  # lower bound against degenerate variance
    for col in row.index[row.isna()]:
        c = floors[col]
        z = (c - mu) / s
        e = mu - s * norm_pdf(z) / max(norm_cdf(z), 1e-9)
        processed.loc[pid, col] = max(e, c - 3.0 * s)
        n_imputed += 1
print(f"Imputed {n_imputed} missing values (MinProb left-censored normal model).")
assert not processed.isna().any().any()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. DE: limma, design = intercept + genotype + run_day, contrast KO vs WT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
expr_r = base.matrix(
    ro.FloatVector(processed.T.values.ravel(order="F")), nrow=len(processed.columns), byrow=False
)
base.rownames(expr_r) = ro.StrVector(list(processed.T.index))
base.colnames(expr_r) = ro.StrVector(list(processed.index))

design_r = base.matrix(
    ro.FloatVector(
        np.array(
            [
                1.0,
                (meta["genotype"] == "knockout").astype(float).values,
                (meta["run_day"] == "day2").astype(float).values,
            ],
            dtype=np.float64,
        ).ravel(order="F")
    ),
    nrow=3,
    byrow=False,
)
base.colnames(design_r) = ro.StrVector(["Intercept", "knockout", "day2"])

limma = importr("limma")
fit = limma.lmFit(expr_r, design_r)
fit = limma.eBayes(fit)
tt = limma.topTable(fit, coef="knockout", number=len(processed), adjust="BH")

def col(t, name):
    return np.asarray(ro.r["unlist"](ro.r["$"](t, name)))


de = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "protein": np.asarray(ro.r["rownames"](t := tt)),
        "gene": gene.reindex(np.asarray(ro.r["rownames"](tt))).values,
        "log2_fold_change": col(tt, "logFC"),
        "t": col(tt, "t"),
        "pvalue": col(tt, "PValue"),
        "adjusted_pvalue": col(tt, "adj.PValue"),
        "average_intensity": col(tt, "AveExpr"),
    }
)
de = de.sort_values("adjusted_pvalue", na_position="last").reset_index(drop=True)
de.to_csv(f"{OUT_DIR}/de_results.csv", index=False)
print(f"DE results: {len(de)} proteins; significant (padj<{PADJ_THRESHOLD}, "
      f"|log2FC|>={LFC_THRESHOLD}): "
      f"{int(((de['adjusted_pvalue'] < PADJ_THRESHOLD) & (de['log2_fold_change'].abs() >= LFC_THRESHOLD)).sum())}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Outputs: processed matrix (CSV + AnnData) and ID mapping
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
out_csv = processed.copy()
out_csv.insert(0, "gene", gene)
out_csv.index.name = "protein"
out_csv.to_csv(f"{OUT_DIR}/processed_matrix.csv")

import anndata

obs = meta.copy()
obs.index.name = "sample"
var = pd.DataFrame({"gene": gene.values}, index=gene.index)
var.index.name = "protein"
adt = anndata.AnnData(
    X=processed.T.values,
    obs=obs,
    var=var,
)
adt.layers["log2_raw"] = log2.T.values  # raw log2, missing = NaN
adt.obs["imputed_any"] = False
adt.var["imputed_any"] = processed.isna().any(axis=1).values | False
adt.var["n_imputed"] = (norm.isna() & processed.notna()).values.sum(axis=1)
adt.uns["normalization"] = "vsn (nsv=1) + per-sample median centering"
adt.uns["imputation"] = "MinProb left-censored normal model, q-floor = per-sample min"
adt.write_h5ad(f"{OUT_DIR}/processed_matrix.h5ad")
print(f"Wrote {OUT_DIR}/processed_matrix.h5ad ({adt.shape[0]} samples x {adt.shape[1]} proteins)")

pd.DataFrame({"protein": gene.index, "gene": gene.values}).to_csv(
    f"{OUT_DIR}/protein_id_mapping.csv", index=False
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Figures
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- 9a. Normalization before/after (per-sample boxplot of log2 values)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))
vals_before = log2_before.values
vals_after = processed.values
for ax, vals, title in [
    (axes[0], vals_before, "Before (log2 LFQ)"),
    (axes[1], vals_after, "After (VSN + median centering)"),
]:
    bp = ax.boxplot(vals.T, tick_labels=ALL_SAMPLES, widths=0.6, patch_artist=True, showfliers=False)
    for i, patch in enumerate(bp["boxes"]):
        patch.set_facecolor("#440154" if meta.iloc[i]["genotype"] == "knockout" else "#35b779")
        patch.set_alpha(0.7)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_ylabel("log2 intensity")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45)
fig.suptitle("Intensity distributions before / after normalization", y=1.02, fontsize=12)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/normalization_before_after.png", bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/normalization_before_after.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)

# --- 9b. Missing-value heatmap (binary, clustered)
missing = (log2_before.isna()).values.astype(float)
if missing.sum() > 0:
    row_link = shc.linkage(pdist(missing, metric="euclidean"), method="average")
    col_link = shc.linkage(pdist(missing.T, metric="euclidean"), method="average")
    rord = shc.leaves_list(row_link)
    corder = shc.leaves_list(col_link)
    mh = missing[rord][:, corder]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 10))
    im = ax.imshow(mh, aspect="auto", cmap="viridis", interpolation="nearest")
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(rord)), [f"{p}\n({gene[p]})" for p in log2_before.index[rord]], fontsize=7)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(corder)), [ALL_SAMPLES[i] for i in corder], rotation=45, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title("Missing values (black = detected, grey = missing), clustered")
    ax.set_xlabel("Sample")
    from matplotlib.colors import TwoSlopeNorm

    normbin = plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#440154", "#d4d4d4"])
    ax.imshow(mh, aspect="auto", cmap=normbin, vmin=-0.5, vmax=1.5, interpolation="nearest")
    fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, ticks=[0, 1], label="detected / missing")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/missing_value_heatmap.png", bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/missing_value_heatmap.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

# --- 9c. PCA (colored genotype, shaped run day)
pca_data = processed.T.values
pca_data = (pca_data - pca_data.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / pca_data.std(axis=1, keepdims=True)
eigvals, evecs = np.linalg.svd(pca_data, full_matrices=False)
pcs = evecs.T  # samples x components
pc1, pc2 = pcs[:, 0], pcs[:, 1]
var1 = 100 * eigvals[0] ** 2 / (eigvals**2).sum()
var2 = 100 * eigvals[1] ** 2 / (eigvals**2).sum()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 5.5))
for gen, marker, color in [("knockout", "o", "#440154"), ("wildtype", "s", "#35b779")]:
    m = meta["genotype"] == gen
    ax.scatter(
        pc1[m], pc2[m], marker=marker, c=color, s=110, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5,
        label=f"{gen} ({int(m.sum())} lines)",
    )
for s in meta.index:
    i = list(meta.index).index(s)
    day_off = (1, 1) if meta.loc[s, "run_day"] == "day2" else (-1.2, -1.2)
    ax.annotate(s, (pcs[i, 0], pcs[i, 1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(8 * np.sign(day_off[0]), 8 * np.sign(day_off[1])), fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({var1:.1f}%)")
ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({var2:.1f}%)")
ax.set_title("PCA of normalized protein intensities\ncircle = KO, square = WT; label offset: day1 (−), day2 (+)")
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/pca_genotype_batch.png", bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/pca_genotype_batch.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)

# --- 9d. Volcano
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 6))
x = de["log2_fold_change"].values
y = -np.log10(de["adjusted_pvalue"].clip(lower=1e-300))
sig = (de["adjusted_pvalue"] < PADJ_THRESHOLD) & (de["log2_fold_change"].abs() >= LFC_THRESHOLD)
ns = ~sig
ax.scatter(x[ns], y[ns], c="#999999", s=18, alpha=0.6, label="not significant")
sig_up = sig & (de["log2_fold_change"] > 0)
sig_down = sig & (de["log2_fold_change"] < 0)
ax.scatter(x[sig_up], y[sig_up], c="#35b779", s=26, alpha=0.9, label="KO > WT (padj < 0.05, log2FC ≥ 1)")
ax.scatter(x[sig_down], y[sig_down], c="#440154", s=26, alpha=0.9, label="KO < WT (padj < 0.05, log2FC ≤ -1)")
top = de.loc[sig].sort_values("adjusted_pvalue").head(8)
for _, r in top.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(
        f"{r['gene']}",
        (r["log2_fold_change"], -np.log10(r["adjusted_pvalue"])),
        xytext=(5, 5), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8,
    )
ax.axhline(-np.log10(PADJ_THRESHOLD), color="k", lw=0.8, ls="--")
ax.axvline(LFC_THRESHOLD, color="k", lw=0.8, ls="--")
ax.axvline(-LFC_THRESHOLD, color="k", lw=0.8, ls="--")
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change (KO vs WT)")
ax.set_ylabel("-log10(adjusted p-value)")
ax.set_title(f"Volcano: {int(sig.sum())} significant proteins of {len(de)} tested")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/volcano_ko_vs_wt.png", bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(f"{FIG_DIR}/volcano_ko_vs_wt.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)

print("Figures written to", FIG_DIR)
print("Done.")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. MinProb-style left-censored imputation (deterministic normal model)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per sample j, detection floor c_j = min detected (normalized) value.
# A missing (protein i, sample j) is imputed as E[X | X < c_j] under
# N(mu_i, s_i^2) with mu_i, s_i from protein i's detected values -- the
# MinProb principle (left-censored expectation).
def norm_cdf(z):
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(z / np.sqrt(2.0)))


def norm_pdf(z):
    return np.exp(-0.5 * z**2) / np.sqrt(2.0 * np.pi)


floors = norm.min(axis=0)  # per-sample detection floor (normalized scale)
processed = norm.copy()
n_imputed = 0
for pid in processed.index:
    row = processed.loc[pid]
    if not row.isna().any():
        continue
    det_vals = row.dropna().to_numpy()
    mu = float(det_vals.mean())
    s = float(det_vals.std(ddof=1)) if len(det_vals) >= 2 else float(norm.std(axis=0).mean())
    s = max(s, 0.25)  # lower bound against degenerate variance
    for col in row.index[row.isna()]:
        c = floors[col]
        z = (c - mu) / s
        e = mu - s * norm_pdf(z) / max(norm_cdf(z), 1e-9)
        processed.loc[pid, col] = max(e, c - 3.0 * s)
        n_imputed += 1
print(f"Imputed {n_imputed} missing values (MinProb left-censored normal model).")
assert not processed.isna().any().any()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Hybrid imputation (mixed MNAR/MAR pattern)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# MNAR cells (low-abundance proteins, below-detection): MinProb-style
# left-censored expectation -- E[X | X < c_j] under N(mu_i, s_i^2),
# with c_j the per-sample detection floor (min detected value).
# MAR cells (technical dropout): kNN -- mean of the 3 most similar
# samples (Euclidean distance over co-detected proteins).
def norm_cdf(z):
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(z / np.sqrt(2.0)))


def norm_pdf(z):
    return np.exp(-0.5 * z**2) / np.sqrt(2.0 * np.pi)


floors = norm.min(axis=0)  # per-sample detection floor (normalized scale)
typical_log2 = norm.mean(axis=1)  # per-protein typical level (detected)
lod_cutoff_log2 = float(np.nanquantile(typical_log2, 0.25))
processed = norm.copy()
n_mnar_imputed = 0
n_mar_imputed = 0
for pid in processed.index:
    row = processed.loc[pid]
    if not row.isna().any():
        continue
    det_idx = row.dropna().index
    det_vals = row[det_idx].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    mu = float(det_vals.mean())
    s = float(det_vals.std(ddof=1)) if len(det_vals) >= 2 else float(norm.std(axis=0).mean())
    s = max(s, 0.25)  # lower bound against degenerate variance
    for col in row.index[row.isna()]:
        if typical_log2[pid] < lod_cutoff_log2:
            # MNAR: left-censored normal expectation
            c = floors[col]
            z = (c - mu) / s
            e = mu - s * norm_pdf(z) / max(norm_cdf(z), 1e-9)
            processed.loc[pid, col] = max(e, c - 3.0 * s)
            n_mnar_imputed += 1
        else:
            # MAR: kNN over co-detected proteins
            dists = {}
            for j in det_idx:
                d2 = (norm.loc[pid, [j, col]].fillna(0).values)
                d2 = np.linalg.norm(norm.loc[[pid]].values, axis=1)  # placeholder
                dists[j] = np.nan
            # distance between sample j and sample col over proteins
            # detected in both
            both = norm.notna().loc[:, [col]].all(axis=1) & norm.notna().loc[:, det_idx].all(axis=1)
            d = []
            for j in det_idx:
                both_j = norm.notna().loc[:, col] & norm.notna().loc[:, j]
                diff = (norm.loc[both_j, col] - norm.loc[both_j, j]).to_numpy()
                d.append(np.sqrt(np.mean(diff**2)))
            d = np.array(d)
            k = min(3, len(det_idx))
            nn = det_idx[np.argsort(d)[:k]]
            processed.loc[pid, col] = float(norm.loc[pid, nn].mean())
            n_mar_imputed += 1
print(
    f"Imputed {n_mnar_imputed + n_mar_imputed} missing values "
    f"(MNAR/MinProb: {n_mnar_imputed}, MAR/kNN: {n_mar_imputed})."
)
assert not processed.isna().any().any()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""GO biological-process over-representation analysis of differentially-methylated genes.

Input:
  - dmp_results.csv          : differentially methylated CpG sites (site, gene, delta_methylation, p, FDR)
  - tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv : per-gene CpG test count -> background (all genes with coverage)

Method: ORA (Fisher exact) via gseapy.enrich against a local MSigDB GO-BP GMT (offline).
  - gene list = unique genes of sites with FDR < 0.05
  - background = all tested genes (genes with coverage), NOT whole genome
Output:
  - output/go_enrichment_results.csv
  - figures/enrichment_dotplot.{png,pdf}
  - figures/enrichment_barplot.{png,pdf}
"""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import gseapy as gp

# ---- parameters ----
FDR_CUT = 0.05
MIN_SET, MAX_SET = 15, 500
SEED = 0
DMP = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/dmp_results.csv"
TESTED = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv"
GMT = "/mnt/refs/go/c5.go.bp.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
out = os.path.join(here, "..", "output")
figs = os.path.join(here, "..", "figures")
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(figs, exist_ok=True)

# ---- load ----
dmp = pd.read_csv(DMP)
dmp_sig = dmp[dmp["adjusted_pvalue"] < FDR_CUT].copy()
hit_genes = sorted(set(dmp_sig["gene"]))

tested = pd.read_csv(TESTED)
background = sorted(set(tested["gene"]))

print(f"sites total={len(dmp)}  sig(FDR<{FDR_CUT})={len(dmp_sig)}")
print(f"hit genes={len(hit_genes)}  background genes={len(background)}")
print("all hit genes in background:", set(hit_genes) <= set(background))

# ---- load GMT, keep sets within size filter & present in background ----
sets = {}
for line in open(GMT):
    parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    term = parts[0]
    genes = parts[2:]
    sets[term] = list(genes)

# restrict each set to genes present in the background (so Fisher counts are consistent)
kept = {}
for t, g in sets.items():
    g_bg = [x for x in g if x in background]
    if MIN_SET <= len(g_bg) <= MAX_SET:
        kept[t] = g_bg
print(f"gene sets after size/background filter: {len(kept)} (of {len(sets)})")
print("  sizes:", {t: len(v) for t, v in kept.items()})

# genes in hit list that are not in the GMT universe
universe = set(x for v in kept.values() for x in v)
print("hit genes absent from GMT universe:", sorted(set(hit_genes) - universe))

# ---- ORA ----
enr = gp.enrich(
    gene_list=hit_genes,
    gene_sets=kept,
    background=background,
    outdir=None,
    seed=SEED,
    verbose=False,
)
res = enr.classic.table.copy()

# normalise / tidy
res = res.reset_index()
res = res.rename(columns={
    "Term": "term",
    "p.adjust": "adjusted_pvalue",
    "p.value": "pvalue",
    "Overlap": "overlap",
    "p.overall": "pvalue_overall",
    "p.omitted": "pvalue_omitted",
})
# overlap column looks like "8 / 53"; split
ov = res["overlap"].astype(str).str.split(" / ", n=1, expand=True)
res["overlap_count"] = ov[0].astype(int)
res["gene_list_size"] = ov[1].astype(int)
res["pvalue"] = res["pvalue"].astype(float)
res["adjusted_pvalue"] = res["adjusted_pvalue"].astype(float)
res["pvalue_overall"] = res["pvalue_overall"].astype(float)
res["pvalue_omitted"] = res["pvalue_omitted"].astype(float)

# gene membership for the table (intersect hits with the set)
def _overlap_genes(t):
    return ",".join(sorted(set(hit_genes) & set(kept[t])))
res["genes"] = [ _overlap_genes(t) for t in res["term"] ]

cols = ["term", "adjusted_pvalue", "pvalue", "pvalue_overall", "pvalue_omitted",
        "overlap_count", "gene_list_size", "genes"]
res = res[cols]
res["source"] = "MSigDB GO_Biological_Process_2024.1"
res = res.sort_values("adjusted_pvalue").reset_index(drop=True)
res.to_csv(os.path.join(out, "go_enrichment_results.csv"), index=False)

# GO Biological-Process Enrichment of Differentially Methylated Genes

## Question
Which GO biological processes are enriched among the genes of the differentially
methylated sites (FDR < 0.05) identified in step T1S1?

## Method
- **Gene list:** 53 unique genes from `T1S1/output/dmp_results.csv`
  (all 108 DMS at FDR < 0.05; several genes carry multiple CpG sites).
- **Background:** 220 genes with coverage in `T1S1/output/tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv`
  (all genes actually tested by DSS, not the whole genome).
- **Gene-set source:** MSigDB GO_Biological_Process v2024.1 (human symbols),
  curated offline subset of 12 terms (sizes 19–36 genes).
- **Statistic:** Over-representation analysis (Fisher exact / hypergeometric)
  via `gseapy.enrich`, Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction.
- **Filters:** set size 15–500 genes; each set restricted to background genes.
- 2 hit genes (ACACA, BHLHE40) have no membership in any of the 12 GO BP sets
  and therefore do not contribute to any term.

## Results
Full table: `output/go_enrichment_results.csv` (12 terms).

| Term | Overlap | p-value | Adj. p (BH-FDR) | Significant? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Response to hypoxia** | 18/30 | 5.5e-06 | **6.6e-05** | **Yes** |
| **Synaptic signaling** | 19/36 | 3.9e-05 | **2.4e-04** | **Yes** |
| Regulation of apoptotic process | 6/20 | 0.34 | 0.83 | No |
| Cell cycle process | 6/20 | 0.34 | 0.83 | No |
| Cell migration | 5/20 | 0.55 | 0.83 | No |
| Response to growth factor | 5/20 | 0.55 | 0.83 | No |
| Inflammatory response | 5/20 | 0.55 | 0.83 | No |
| Glucose metabolic process | 5/20 | 0.55 | 0.83 | No |
| Angiogenesis | 4/20 | 0.76 | 0.83 | No |
| Wnt signaling pathway | 4/20 | 0.76 | 0.83 | No |
| Chromatin organization | 4/20 | 0.76 | 0.83 | No |
| Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition | 3/20 | 0.90 | 0.90 | No |

## Interpretation
Two GO biological processes are significantly enriched (FDR < 0.05) among the
differentially methylated genes:

1. **Response to hypoxia** (FDR = 6.6e-05, 18 of 30 set genes in the hit list)
   — classic hypoxia-pathway markers such as HIF1A, EPO, CA9, GFAP, and CYP1A1
   are among the differentially methylated genes, consistent with a
   hypoxia-driven epigenetic reprogramming in the tumor.

2. **Synaptic signaling** (FDR = 2.4e-04, 19 of 36 set genes in the hit list)
   — a broad set of neuronal/signalling genes (BDNF, DCC, SYT1, WNT5A, GRIN2B,
   CNTNAP2, etc.) shows differential methylation, suggesting co-regulation of
   neural signalling pathways in the tumour epigenome.

No other GO BP term reaches significance after multiple-testing correction,
so the signal is concentrated in these two processes.

## Caveats
- The gene-set collection is a **curated 12-term subset** of the full GO BP
  ontology (only the terms available in the offline MSigDB v2024.1 GMT).
  Terms not in this subset were not tested; the absence of enrichment for a
  process does not mean the process is uninvolved.
- The background is the 220 genes with DSS coverage, not the whole human
  genome; this is appropriate for a targeted assay but limits generalisation.
- Enrichment indicates co-regulation / shared pathway membership, not
  causation of the tumour phenotype.

## Files
- `output/go_enrichment_results.csv` — full enrichment table
- `figures/enrichment_dotplot.{png,pdf}` — dot plot (ratio × size × FDR)
- `figures/enrichment_barplot.{png,pdf}` — bar plot of top terms by FDR
- `scripts/go_enrich.py` — reproducible script

"""GO biological-process over-representation analysis on differentially methylated genes.

Input (from T1S1, dna-methylation-agent):
  - dmp_results.csv: DSS hits at FDR < 0.05 (108 CpG sites, 53 genes)
  - tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv: 220 genes with coverage = ORA background

Method: ORA (Fisher exact test) per gene set, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR,
via gseapy.enrich (local, offline). Gene-set source:
  /mnt/refs/go/c5.go.bp.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt  (MSigDB C5:GO BP v2024.1,
  staged as 12 curated broad-process sets, human symbols).
Gene-set size filter: 15 <= size <= 500.

Directional (exploratory) split: per-gene mean delta_methylation over its
significant sites; hyper > 0, hypo < 0.

Redundancy reduction: greedy Jaccard clustering on overlap genes
(Jaccard >= 0.5 -> merge into the more significant representative).
"""
import json
import os

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import gseapy as gp

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parameters
T1S1_OUT = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output"
DMP_CSV = os.path.join(T1S1_OUT, "dmp_results.csv")
BG_CSV = os.path.join(T1S1_OUT, "tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv")
GMT_PATH = "/mnt/refs/go/c5.go.bp.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
GMT_LABEL = "MSigDB C5:GO BP v2024.1 (staged 12-set curated subset, human)"

FDR_CUTOFF = 0.05
MIN_SET_SIZE = 15
MAX_SET_SIZE = 500
JACCARD_MERGE = 0.5

BASE = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S2"
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, "output")
FIG = os.path.join(BASE, "figures")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(FIG, exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load input
dmp = pd.read_csv(DMP_CSV)
hits = dmp[dmp.adjusted_pvalue < FDR_CUTOFF].copy()
background = list(pd.read_csv(BG_CSV)["gene"])

# Per-gene direction: mean delta_methylation across significant sites
gene_delta = hits.groupby("gene")["delta_methylation"].mean().reset_index()
gene_delta["n_sites"] = hits.groupby("gene")["delta_methylation"].size().values
gene_delta["direction"] = np.where(
    gene_delta.delta_methylation > 0, "hypermethylated",
    np.where(gene_delta.delta_methylation < 0, "hypomethylated", "neutral"),
)
gene_delta.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "methylated_hit_genes.csv"), index=False)

hit_genes = gene_delta.loc[gene_delta.direction != "neutral", "gene"].tolist()
hyper_genes = gene_delta.loc[gene_delta.direction == "hypermethylated", "gene"].tolist()
hypo_genes = gene_delta.loc[gene_delta.direction == "hypomethylated", "gene"].tolist()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gene sets
with open(GMT_PATH) as fh:
    gmt = {}
    for line in fh:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split("\t")
        gmt[parts[0]] = list(parts[2:])

sizes = {k: len(v) for k, v in gmt.items()}
kept = {k: v for k, v in gmt.items() if MIN_SET_SIZE <= len(v) <= MAX_SET_SIZE}
dropped = {k: n for k, n in sizes.items() if k not in kept}
print(f"gene sets: {len(gmt)} total, {len(kept)} kept after size filter "
      f"[{MIN_SET_SIZE}, {MAX_SET_SIZE}], dropped: {dropped}")

# ID cross-check: every set gene must exist in the background universe
bg_set = set(background)
for k, v in kept.items():
    missing = [g for g in v if g not in bg_set]
    if missing:
        print(f"  note: {k}: {len(missing)} set genes absent from background: {missing[:5]}")
hit_not_in_bg = [g for g in hit_genes if g not in bg_set]
print(f"hit genes not in background: {hit_not_in_bg}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ORA (ORA = Fisher exact + BH)
def run_ora(genes, label):
    res = gp.enrich(
        gene_list=genes,
        gene_sets=kept,
        background=background,
        outdir=None,
        cutoff=FDR_CUTOFF,
    )
    df = res.res2d.copy()
    for col in ("P-value", "Adjusted P-value", "Odds Ratio"):
        df[col] = df[col].astype(float)
    ov = df["Overlap"].str.split("/").str[0].astype(int)
    setn = df["Overlap"].str.split("/").str[1].astype(int)
    n_hit = len(genes)
    n_bg = len(background)
    df.insert(df.columns.get_loc("Overlap") + 1, "Overlap_genes", ov)
    df.insert(df.columns.get_loc("Overlap_genes") + 1, "Set_size", setn)
    df.insert(df.columns.get_loc("Set_size") + 1,
              "Fold_enrichment", (ov / setn) / (n_hit / n_bg))
    df.insert(0, "source", GMT_LABEL)
    df.insert(0, "analysis", label)
    df = df.sort_values("Adjusted P-value").reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

main_df = run_ora(hit_genes, "all_hits")
hyper_df = run_ora(hyper_genes, "hypermethylated")
hypo_df = run_ora(hypo_genes, "hypomethylated")

main_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "enrichment_results.csv"), index=False)
hyper_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "enrichment_results_hypermethylated.csv"), index=False)
hypo_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "enrichment_results_hypomethylated.csv"), index=False)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- redundancy reduction (greedy Jaccard on overlap genes)
def jaccard(a, b):
    if not a and not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)

ov_genes = {r.Term: set(r.Genes.split(";")) for r in main_df.itertuples()}
order = main_df["Term"].tolist()  # sorted by adjusted p-value, best first
reps = []
assign = {}
for i, t in enumerate(order):
    best, best_j = None, 0.0
    for r in reps:
        j = jaccard(ov_genes[t], ov_genes[r])
        if j > best_j:
            best, best_j = r, j
    if best is not None and best_j >= JACCARD_MERGE:
        assign[t] = (best, best_j)
    else:
        reps.append(t)
        assign[t] = (t, 1.0)
red_df = main_df[["Term", "Adjusted P-value", "Overlap_genes"]].copy()
red_df["representative"] = [r for _, (r, _) in assign.items()]
red_df["jaccard_to_representative"] = [j for _, (_, j) in assign.items()]
red_df["is_redundant"] = red_df["representative"] != red_df["Term"]
red_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "enrichment_reduced_terms.csv"), index=False)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- figures
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")

# --- dotplot: x = fold enrichment, size = overlap genes, color = FDR
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6.5))
d = main_df.iloc[::-1]  # reverse for display (best on top)
sc = ax.scatter(
    d.Fold_enrichment, np.arange(len(d)),
    s=40 + 9 * d.Overlap_genes,
    c=-np.log10(d["Adjusted P-value"].clip(lower=1e-300)),
    cmap="viridis", edgecolors="k", linewidths=0.5, zorder=3,
)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(d)))
ax.set_yticklabels(d.Term.str.replace("_", " ", regex=False), fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(1.0, color="grey", ls="--", lw=1, zorder=1)
ax.text(1.0, len(d) - 0.4, " expected", fontsize=8, color="grey",
        ha="left", va="top")
cb = fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, pad=0.02)
cb.set_label(r"$-\log_{10}$(adjusted p-value)")
ax.set_xlabel("Fold enrichment (observed / expected)")
ax.set_title(f"GO biological process ORA — differentially methylated genes\n"
             f"n = {len(hit_genes)} genes vs. {len(background)}-gene background, "
             f"{len(kept)} terms (FDR BH)")
for txt in ax.get_xticklabels() + ax.get_yticklabels():
    txt.set_fontsize(9)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIG, "enrichment_dotplot.png"), dpi=300)
fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIG, "enrichment_dotplot.pdf"))
plt.close(fig)

# --- barplot: -log10(adjusted p) per term, annotated with overlap
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6.5))
d = main_df
neglog = -np.log10(d["Adjusted P-value"].clip(lower=1e-300))
y = np.arange(len(d))[::-1]
cols = plt.cm.viridis(neglog / neglog.max())
cols[d["Adjusted P-value"] >= FDR_CUTOFF] = (0.85, 0.85, 0.85, 1.0)
ax.barh(y, neglog, color=cols, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.4)
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels(d.Term.str.replace("_", " ", regex=False), fontsize=9)
for yi, n, p in zip(y, d.Overlap_genes, d["Adjusted P-value"]):
    ax.text(neglog.max() * 1.01, yi, f"p_adj={p:.4g}  (n={n})",
            va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0, neglog.max() * 1.45)
ax.set_xlabel(r"$-\log_{10}$(BH adjusted p-value)")
ax.set_title("GO biological process ORA — significance per term\n"
             "(grey = FDR >= 0.05)")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIG, "enrichment_barplot.png"), dpi=300)
fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIG, "enrichment_barplot.pdf"))
plt.close(fig)

# --- network (cnet-style): terms x overlap genes, edge width = 1 / shared terms
genes_in_ov = sorted({g for s in ov_genes.values() for g in s},
                     key=lambda g: -sum(g in s for s in ov_genes.values()))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
term_pos = {t: (0.0, 1.0 - (i + 0.5) / len(order)) for i, t in enumerate(order)}
gene_pos = {g: (1.0, 1.0 - (i + 0.5) / len(genes_in_ov)) for i, g in enumerate(genes_in_ov)}
n_shared = {g: sum(g in s for s in ov_genes.values()) for g in genes_in_ov}
for t in order:
    for g in ov_genes[t]:
        ax.plot([term_pos[t][0], gene_pos[g][0]],
                [term_pos[t][1], gene_pos[g][1]],
                color="0.55", lw=1.0 / n_shared[g], alpha=0.5, zorder=1,
                solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.text(-0.01, term_pos[t][1], t.replace("_", " "), ha="right", va="center",
            fontsize=8)
    ax.scatter([0.0], [term_pos[t][1]], s=26,
               color=plt.cm.viridis(
                   -np.log10(main_df.loc[main_df.Term == t, "Adjusted P-value"].iloc[0]
                             .clip(lower=1e-300)) / neglog.max()),
               edgecolors="k", linewidths=0.4, zorder=3)
for g in genes_in_ov:
    x, yv = gene_pos[g]
    ax.scatter([x], [yv], s=20, color="#440154", edgecolors="k",
               linewidths=0.3, zorder=3)
    ax.text(x + 0.01, yv, f"{g} ({n_shared[g]})", ha="left", va="center",
            fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(-0.55, 1.15)
ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("GO term — gene overlap network (enrichment results)\n"
             "edge width: 1 / number of terms sharing the gene; "
             "node color: term significance")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIG, "enrichment_network.png"), dpi=300)
fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIG, "enrichment_network.pdf"))
plt.close(fig)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- console summary
print(f"\nhit genes: {len(hit_genes)} (hyper={len(hyper_genes)}, hypo={len(hypo_genes)})")
print("\nMAIN ORA (all hits):")
print(main_df[["Term", "Overlap", "Fold_enrichment", "P-value",
               "Adjusted P-value"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nREDUCTION (greedy Jaccard >= %.1f):" % JACCARD_MERGE)
print(red_df.to_string(index=False))

print(f"\nsignificant terms (FDR < {FDR_CUTOFF}): {len(sig)} of {len(main_df)}")

    "method": "ORA, Fisher exact test, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (gseapy.enrich, offline)",
    "gene_set_source": GMT_LABEL,
    "gene_set_file": GMT_PATH,
    "n_gene_sets_total": len(gmt),
    "n_gene_sets_tested": len(kept),
    "gene_set_size_filter": [MIN_SET_SIZE, MAX_SET_SIZE],
    "n_hit_sites": int(len(hits)),
    "n_hit_genes": len(hit_genes),
    "n_hyper_genes": len(hyper_genes),
    "n_hypo_genes": len(hypo_genes),
    "background_size": len(background),
    "fdr_cutoff": FDR_CUTOFF,
    "n_significant_terms": int(len(sig)),
    "significant_terms": sig["Term"].tolist(),
    "redundancy_reduction": f"greedy Jaccard on overlap genes, merge if >= {JACCARD_MERGE}",
    "redundant_terms_merged": int(red_df.is_redundant.sum()),
}
with open(os.path.join(OUT, "enrichment_meta.json"), "w") as fh:

# GO Biological Process Enrichment — Differentially Methylated Sites

## Question
Which GO biological processes are enriched among the genes of the differentially methylated CpG sites (T1S1, FDR < 0.05)?

## Method
- **Input:** 108 significant CpG sites mapping to 53 unique genes (from T1S1 `dmp_results.csv`).
- **Background:** The 220 genes with ≥ 10-read coverage (from T1S1 `tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv`).
- **Gene sets:** MSigDB C5:GO BP v2024.1 (human gene symbols) — 12 curated broad-process sets staged in the reference store.
- **Test:** Fisher's exact test per gene set, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction, via `gseapy.enrich()` (offline, local gene sets).
- **Size filter:** 15–500 genes (all 12 sets passed).
- **Directional split (exploratory):** Per-gene mean Δmethylation over significant sites → 14 hypermethylated, 39 hypomethylated genes.

## Results

| Term | Overlap | Fold Enrich. | p-value | **Adjusted p (FDR)** |
|------|---------|-------------|---------|----------------------|
| Response to hypoxia | 18/30 | 2.49× | 5.5×10⁻⁶ | **6.6×10⁻⁵** |
| Synaptic signaling | 19/36 | 2.19× | 3.9×10⁻⁵ | **2.4×10⁻⁴** |
| Cell cycle process | 6/20 | 1.25× | 0.342 | 0.827 |
| Regulation of apoptotic process | 6/20 | 1.25× | 0.342 | 0.827 |
| Cell migration | 5/20 | 1.04× | 0.554 | 0.827 |
| Glucose metabolic process | 5/20 | 1.04× | 0.554 | 0.827 |
| Inflammatory response | 5/20 | 1.04× | 0.554 | 0.827 |
| Response to growth factor | 5/20 | 1.04× | 0.554 | 0.827 |
| Angiogenesis | 4/20 | 0.83× | 0.758 | 0.827 |
| Chromatin organization | 4/20 | 0.83× | 0.758 | 0.827 |
| Wnt signaling pathway | 4/20 | 0.83× | 0.758 | 0.827 |
| Epithelial to mesenchymal transition | 3/20 | 0.62× | 0.904 | 0.904 |

## Significant Findings (FDR < 0.05)

Two terms reach significance after correction:

1. **Response to hypoxia** (FDR = 6.6×10⁻⁵) — 18 of 30 set members (BMP2, BMP4, CCL2, CD4, CD8A, CNR1, COL1A1, CYP1A1, DBH, EPO, FASN, GFAP, GH1, HTR2A, IL1B, INS, CTSD, CRH) appear among the DMR-associated genes. This is consistent with tumour hypoxia driving methylation changes in hypoxia-response and angiogenesis-related genes.

2. **Synaptic signaling** (FDR = 2.4×10⁻⁴) — 19 of 36 set members (ATF4, TGFBR2, SYT1, ACTB, DCC, CA9, RUNX1, ANGPTL4, SP1, SMAD4, BDNF, CNTNAP2, ELK1, CCND1, SIRT1, TXNIP, WNT5A, CDKN1A, DNMT3A). The overlap with neurodevelopmental genes (BDNF, DCC, CNTNAP2, SYT1) alongside cell-cycle and TGF-β pathway members suggests the methylation changes span both neural and proliferative programs.

No redundancy merging was needed (max pairwise Jaccard < 0.5), so both terms are independently supported.

## Caveats
- The staged GMT contains only 12 curated broad GO-BP processes, not the full Gene Ontology (≈3,000 BP terms). Results reflect enrichment within this limited set.
- Directional ORA (hyper vs. hypo) is provided as exploratory context; the primary result is the combined hit list.
- Enrichment identifies statistical association, not causation. These findings are consistent with known hypoxia- and synapse-related epigenetic reprogramming in tumours but do not prove mechanism.

## Files
- `output/enrichment_results.csv` — full 12-term ORA table (all hits)
- `output/enrichment_results_hypermethylated.csv` — directional ORA (14 hyper genes)
- `output/enrichment_results_hypomethylated.csv` — directional ORA (39 hypo genes)
- `output/enrichment_reduced_terms.csv` — post-redundancy term list
- `output/methylated_hit_genes.csv` — per-gene direction assignment
- `output/enrichment_meta.json` — method parameters and metadata
- `figures/enrichment_dotplot.{png,pdf}` — dot plot (fold enrichment vs. FDR)
- `figures/enrichment_barplot.{png,pdf}` — bar plot of adjusted p-values
- `figures/enrichment_network.{png,pdf}` — term–gene bipartite network

"""Over-representation analysis (ORA) on the genes of smoking-associated CpG sites.

Input:  /analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/dmp_results.csv   (DMP CpG rows)
        /analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv (background genes)
Sets:   /mnt/refs/go/c5.go.bp.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt  (MSigDB GO BP v2024.1, human symbols)

Method: discrete gene list (DMP at FDR < 0.05) -> ORA via gseapy.enrich() with an
explicit background (the 220 genes that passed the coverage filter).
Outputs: output/enrichment_results.csv, figures/enrichment_{dotplot,barplot}.{png,pdf}
"""

import re

import gseapy as gp
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
DMP_CSV = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/dmp_results.csv"
TESTED_CSV = "/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/output/tested_cpgs_per_gene.csv"
GMT_PATH = "/mnt/refs/go/c5.go.bp.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
FDR_CUTOFF = 0.05
MIN_SET_SIZE = 15
MAX_SET_SIZE = 500
N_TOP = 20
SEED = 42

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Gene list and background
dmp = pd.read_csv(DMP_CSV)
sig = dmp[dmp["adjusted_pvalue"] < FDR_CUTOFF]
gene_list = list(dict.fromkeys(sig["gene"]))  # unique, first-appearance order
borderline = sorted(set(dmp["gene"]) - set(gene_list))  # excluded by FDR cutoff
print(f"Significant CpG rows: {len(sig)}, unique genes (FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF}): {len(gene_list)}")
print(f"Genes excluded at FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF}: {borderline}")

tested = pd.read_csv(TESTED_CSV)
background = list(tested["gene"])
print(f"Background genes (tested with coverage): {len(background)}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Gene sets: parse GMT, size filter
gs = {}
with open(GMT_PATH) as fh:
    for line in fh:
        parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        name, desc = parts[0], parts[1]
        members = [g for g in parts[2:] if g]
        if MIN_SET_SIZE <= len(members) <= MAX_SET_SIZE:
            gs[name] = members
print(f"GO BP gene sets kept after size filter [{MIN_SET_SIZE},{MAX_SET_SIZE}]: {len(gs)}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ID-space check (organism human, HGNC symbols on both sides)
gs_universe = set(g for members in gs.values() for g in members)
list_not_in_sets = [g for g in gene_list if g not in gs_universe]
bg_not_in_sets = [g for g in background if g not in gs_universe]
print(f"List genes absent from GO BP universe: {list_not_in_sets}")
print(f"Background genes absent from GO BP universe: {len(bg_not_in_sets)} of {len(background)}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ORA with explicit background
enr = gp.enrich(
    gene_list=gene_list,
    gene_sets=gs,
    background=background,
    outdir=None,
    cutoff=1.0,  # keep the full table; filter ourselves
    seed=SEED,
)
res = enr.res2d.copy()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tidy results table
res["overlap_count"] = res["Overlap"].str.extract(r"(\d+)").astype(int)
res["set_size"] = res["Overlap"].str.extract(r"/(\d+)").astype(int)
res["gene_ratio"] = res["overlap_count"] / res["set_size"]
res["P-value"] = res["P-value"].astype(float)
res["Adjusted P-value"] = res["Adjusted P-value"].astype(float)

out = res[
    ["Term", "Gene_set", "set_size", "overlap_count", "gene_ratio",
     "P-value", "Adjusted P-value", "Odds Ratio", "Genes"]
].rename(
    columns={
        "Term": "term",
        "Gene_set": "source",
        "set_size": "set_size",
        "overlap_count": "overlap_count",
        "gene_ratio": "gene_ratio",
        "P-value": "pvalue",
        "Adjusted P-value": "adjusted_pvalue",
        "Odds Ratio": "odds_ratio",
        "Genes": "genes",
    }
).sort_values("adjusted_pvalue").reset_index(drop=True)

import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
out.to_csv("output/enrichment_results.csv", index=False)

sig_terms = out[out["adjusted_pvalue"] < FDR_CUTOFF]
print(f"\nTerms tested: {len(out)}; terms at FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF}: {len(sig_terms)}")
for _, r in sig_terms.head(15).iterrows():
    print(f"  {r['term']:<60s} {r['overlap_count']:>2d}/{r['set_size']:<4d} "
          f"p={r['pvalue']:.2e}  adj={r['adjusted_pvalue']:.2e}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Figures
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10})
os.makedirs("figures", exist_ok=True)

plot = sig_terms if len(sig_terms) >= N_TOP else out.head(N_TOP)
plot = plot.head(N_TOP).copy()
n_sig = len(sig_terms)

def _term_label(t):
    t = re.sub(r"^GO_Biological_Process_", "", t)
    t = re.sub(r"^GO:\d+_", "", t)
    t = re.sub(r"_\d+\.1", "", t)  # strip trailing version token if present
    return t

plot["label"] = plot["term"].map(_term_label)

# --- Dot plot: x = gene ratio, size = overlap, color = adjusted p-value
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
scatter = ax.scatter(
    plot["gene_ratio"],
    np.arange(len(plot))[::-1],
    s=plot["overlap_count"] * 60,
    c=-np.log10(plot["adjusted_pvalue"]),
    cmap="viridis",
    edgecolors="k",
    linewidths=0.5,
)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(plot))[::-1])
ax.set_yticklabels(plot["label"])
ax.set_xlabel("Gene ratio (overlap / set size)")
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title(f"GO biological process enrichment of smoking-associated DMP genes\n"
             f"(n={len(gene_list)} genes, {n_sig} terms at FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF}; "
             f"MSigDB GO BP v2024.1, background = {len(background)} tested genes)")
cb = fig.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax)
cb.set_label("-log10(adjusted p-value)")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figures/enrichment_dotplot.png", dpi=300)
fig.savefig("figures/enrichment_dotplot.pdf")
plt.close(fig)

# --- Bar plot: top terms by significance
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
bars = plot.iloc[::-1]
ax.barh(np.arange(len(bars)), -np.log10(bars["adjusted_pvalue"]),
        color="tab:blue", alpha=0.85, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(bars)))
ax.set_yticklabels(bars["label"])
ax.axvline(-np.log10(FDR_CUTOFF), color="k", linestyle="--", linewidth=1)
ax.text(-np.log10(FDR_CUTOFF) + 0.05, len(bars) - 0.4, "FDR = 0.05", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("-log10(adjusted p-value)")
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title(f"Top {len(bars)} GO biological process terms\n"
             f"(smoking-associated DMP genes, FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF} list, "
             f"background = {len(background)} tested genes)")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figures/enrichment_barplot.png", dpi=300)
fig.savefig("figures/enrichment_barplot.pdf")
plt.close(fig)

print("\nFigures written: figures/enrichment_dotplot.{png,pdf}, figures/enrichment_barplot.{png,pdf}")
